name: EPIC 217012402
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 7, 10.9 solar radii and 0.91 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 217012402 (K2 campaign 7): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.871219 (16th-84th percentiles 10.538256-11.242599), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 4,157 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 7, give 0.91 solar masses and 10.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,774 K at its surface.
